metaDescription: ElevenLabs is an AI audio platform for text-to-speech, voice cloning, dubbing, sound effects, music and voice agents, with an API. See its features, Free to Business pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: ElevenLabs is an AI audio platform for realistic text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning, dubbing, sound effects and music. Creators use its web studio to voice videos, audiobooks and podcasts, and developers use its API to add voice to their apps.

ElevenLabs also offers voice agents for phone and chat, and image and video generation on paid plans. Usage is measured in monthly credits. The free plan includes 10,000 credits a month, about 10 minutes of audio, but doesn't include a commercial license; paid plans add commercial use, voice cloning and more credits.

features.title: Text to Speech
features.text: Lifelike AI voices from the web studio or the API.

features.title: Voice cloning
features.text: Instant Voice Cloning from Starter, and Professional Voice Cloning from Creator.

features.title: Voice Design
features.text: Generate new voices from a text description of tone, accent and delivery.

features.title: Dubbing and Studio
features.text: Translate and dub audio and video, and produce long-form projects in Studio.

features.title: Sound effects and music
features.text: Generate sound effects and music, with commercial music use on paid plans.

features.title: Voice agents
features.text: Build AI voice agents for calls and text, with included call minutes per plan.

useCases: AI voice agents for customer support
Adding voice to apps via the API
strengths: Lifelike AI voices, from the web studio or the API.
A free plan with 10,000 credits a month.
One platform for speech, dubbing, sound effects, music and agents.
Paid plans start low, at $6/mo with a $1 first month.
limitations: The free plan has no commercial license and requires crediting ElevenLabs.
Voice cloning isn't available on the free plan.
Video generation needs a paid plan.
Professional Voice Cloning needs the Creator plan or higher.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Plans include monthly credits for audio, image and video generation. Yearly billing gives 2 months free. Introductory first-month discounts apply to Starter and Creator.
